jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: Synthetic role: partner with a product team to design experiments, analyze customer behavior and communicate uncertainty. Own reproducible Python and SQL analyses, not only dashboards. Expected experience: at least 3 years of relevant applied analysis.

Write SQL joins, aggregations and analytical queries.
Design and interpret controlled experiments with statistical uncertainty.
At least 3 years of relevant applied analysis experience.
